versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the sold-price-comps skill.
- Quickly look up recent sold prices and current market comps for any product using the 3rd Place Provisions sold-prices MCP endpoint.
- No API keys or signup required—pay per call via x402 protocol is supported.
- Returns structured data including title, price, condition, source, and sold date (where available) across categories like video games, sneakers, collectibles, and electronics.
- Free tier available; $0.05 per call for regular use.
